bug: The scaffold's recharts 3.10.1 does not render the original's chart SVG: each layer group carries a class (recharts-zIndex-layer_-100 ... _2000) and each line path sits inside an extra <g class="recharts-layer recharts-shape">, where the original has bare <g> layers and the path directly under the line group. acct_poly scored DOM 0.9432 (36 differing lines of 348), acct_kalshi 0.9494 (30 of 314).
caught_by: parity DOM diff on acct_poly and acct_kalshi, both viewports (evals/out/diff/acct_poly_d.dom.diff)
fix: Identified the original's version from its bundle (has the rangeMin/rangeMax strings added in 3.7.0, lacks the recharts-zIndex-layer class added in 3.8.0) and pinned recharts to exactly 3.7.0. With it the chart lines of the DOM diff are empty (3 differing lines left, none in the chart). A running dev server keeps its prebundled copy of the old version until it is restarted.

bug: The scenario clicked Previous month 13 times, but the Kalshi history for this trader starts in May 2026, so the button is disabled after 6 clicks and the 7th click timed out on the original as well as the replica.
caught_by: parity printed ORIGINAL-FAILED: TimeoutError: locator.click: Timeout 8000ms exceeded for tp_kalshi_calendar_earliest on both viewports
fix: Read the first history timestamp from the API (2026-05-05) and set the scenario to 6 clicks, which lands on the earliest month with its before-tracking cells and the disabled button.

bug: A trader whose picture is hosted by the API itself has pfp https://predicting.top/api/wallet-avatar/<wallet>. The page-local avatar helper only rewrote X image URLs, so the replica rendered the absolute upstream URL (the browser fetched the picture from the original's host, past the replica's own API layer) where the original renders the same-origin path /api/wallet-avatar/<wallet>.
caught_by: parity DOM diff on tp_hyperliquid_unnamed, both viewports: img src /api/wallet-avatar/0xd3a8... on the original, https://predicting.top/api/wallet-avatar/0xd3a8... on the replica
fix: Dropped the page-local copy and used largeAvatar from app/src/lib/avatar.ts, which maps the API's own absolute URLs to same-origin paths. The scenario stays as the check.
